name: career-coach
description: Evidence-grounded career direction, opportunity fit and lifecycle tracking with durable records, and resume tailoring from verified evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Career decisions, opportunity tracking, and resumes
interface.longDescription: Clarify career direction, evaluate and track specific opportunities from both sides, and tailor resumes without inventing or overstating evidence.
defaultPrompt: Help me clarify what I should target next in my career.
Evaluate whether this opportunity fits me and whether I fit it.
Tailor my resume to this role using only supported facts.
